_why: E04: same recipe as E01, trained on Haiku labels (rubric v1.4-1.7, 2,680 train / 200 val, all rule-checked) instead of 3,687 heuristic labels. Haiku agrees with gold on 94-100% of moves vs the heuristic's 61%: if the student copies its teacher, gold accuracy should rise, most for balanced, real estate and business sims, with fewer labels. A later run on all 3,687 Haiku labels gives the data-size curve.
